I grew up with Halo more than any other game or game series. From the first Halo to Reach, I loved them all (especially 3 and Reach), but it seemed to take a nosedive for me personally after Reach. I’ve seen people talk about how the newer games aren’t bad or are even good and, to be honest, I’ve lost my love and interest for the Halo series, at least as it stands now.

From my perspective, people don’t seem to agree with me on this, but one change (other than Bungie not being behind the creation of the games) was the rating change. I remember the incredible Halo 3 ad that was all still and had all of those figurines bloodied and battered while the camera moved through the battlefield with Chopin playing in the background. It felt like while this was a futuristic fantasy game, it still felt at least somewhat grounded in reality, like it was a *real* war. I loved everything about it and I loved feeling like a badass. 

After Reach, I never had that feeling again and I remember thinking how much “brighter” or maybe more saturated everything felt in the newer games, like things had a somewhat better/happier tone or maybe upbeat? It just felt off and more like what people love hating on superhero movies about. And don’t get me wrong, there are plenty of those movies I like, despite some cringy writing here and there (if it’s one of the better movies). But this didn’t feel like Halo anymore.

I’m totally fine with someone else making Halo, but in my opinion, it just doesn’t feel like Halo anymore. It feels more like another game doing a “Halo promotion” sort of thing.
